text:
Jamie: Quick RFC follow-up: propose splitting hot inference slab from batch/enrichment slab to reduce p99 tail and shrink hotpath surface. Want to capture cutover plan and gating.

Sandeep: Good. Two blockers: session metadata ownership post-split? and KV cache coordination.

Lia: Recommend dual-write for metadata during cutover + read-fallback to old slab. Fast rollback.

Alex: Dual-write ok but causes metrics duplication. Alternative: deploy a feature-flagged read-proxy that centralizes routing and billing events.

Maria: Observability requirements: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 histograms, tracing on canary, and synthetic long-context prompts. Canary should start at 1% with full trace sampling.

Kevin: O perations: 3-stage rollout: 1) extract slab-api package (compile-time), 2) deploy read-proxy sidecar (flagged), 3) enable dual-write for 48h then ramp cohorts 1->10->50->100 with automated SLO checks. Schedule nightly maintenance windows.

Jamie: Short plan and tradeoffs: dual-write = easier rollback but data movement; proxy = cleaner but adds latency risk if caching is mishandled. Need explicit gates: error-rate threshold, p95 tail regression, token-cost delta.

Jamie: Rollout snippet:
# rollout plan
step 0: feature-flag scaffold and tests
step 1: extract public inference API into slab-api package
step 2: deploy read-proxy sidecar behind flag + enable tracing
step 3: enable dual-write for session metadata for 48h
step 4: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with eval & SLO gates
fallback: flip flag to old path, disable writes, drain new slab

Sandeep: On cache invalidation: use namespaced keys, cache-lease TTLs, and emit migration invalidation events. Propose conservative 10s TTL during cutover, relax after 72h stable.

Lia: Agrees on TTL and namespacing.

Alex: To avoid billing double-counting, emit canonical billing events only from proxy during dual-write.

Maria: Eval gating: run eval set A against canary responses; if critical prompt regressions >0.5%, pause ramp. Also run perplexity + token usage diff.

Kevin: Ops checklist additions: DB migrator dry-run, background backfill with rate limiter, circuit-breaker for new slab, rollback playbook in runbook. On-call + infra buddy during each ramp.

Jamie: Ownership matrix draft: slab-api (eng-runtime), read-proxy (eng-platform), migration/backfill (eng-infra), monitoring/evals (eng-ml + observability). I'll update RFC with sequence and gating metrics.

Sandeep: Can we align on a 1-hr sign-off sync? Wed 09:30 PST works.

Alex: I'll bring the proxy PoC and metric dedupe plan.

Maria: I'll add the eval harness and synthetic tail-flood runner.

Kevin: I'll book maintenance windows and ensure runbook links.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: branch slab-api-extract -> pipeline #4128. ETA: 2026-03-20 01:22 UTC. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/4128 :robot_face:

Jamie: Action items recap: Alex PoC, Maria eval harness, Kevin ops runbook, Sandeep TTL/key namespacing doc. Will post updated RFC after sync. :thumbsup:
